findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation in document access checks
findings.body: When `userTenant !== documentTenant`, this exported authorization check now returns `true`. Consumers relying on it can therefore disclose documents across tenant boundaries; preserve the tenant equality check or implement an equivalent authorization policy.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation in document access checks
findings.body:
When `userTenant !== documentTenant`, the function now returns `true`, allowing any consumer relying on this exported authorization check to expose documents across tenants.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation in the document-read authorization check
findings.body:
The function now authorizes every read regardless of tenant. Any request where `userTenant !== documentTenant` will be granted access, enabling cross-tenant document disclosure wherever this authorization primitive is used.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
